about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a frontend-focused full stack and mobile engineer based in Lagos, building products across React, React Native, Flutter, Next.js and Node.js. My work sits at the intersection of interface craft and system design — I care as much about how a screen feels as I do about how the API behind it holds up under load.

Over the last few years I've shipped AI-powered ordering assistants, multi-vendor marketplaces, real-time social platforms and food delivery ecosystems — the kind of products where uptime and latency aren't abstract metrics, they're vendors waiting on orders and customers watching a spinner.

I currently lead frontend and mobile engineering at Varsigram, build the mobile experience at Local Eats Africa, mentor developers at CoderTech, and take on freelance builds for founders who need someone who can own a product from architecture to deployment.

points: Lead frontend and mobile engineering initiatives across multiple products.
Design scalable application architectures and reusable component systems for React Native and React.
Run code reviews and set engineering standards across the team.
Mentor developers on TypeScript, architecture and debugging.
Partner with product, design and backend to ship production-ready features.
Built a multi-vendor food delivery ecosystem supporting 150+ vendors.
Shipped customer ordering, vendor management, authentication, payments and live order tracking.
Helped maintain 99.9% uptime across production systems.
Cut API latency by 40% through caching and frontend optimization.
Drove a 20% increase in user retention through analytics-led improvements.
Optimized for low-bandwidth environments and diverse Android devices.
Mentor developers in React Native, Flutter and frontend architecture.
Teach project-based courses on auth, APIs, state management and deployment.
Guide students through professional GitHub workflows.
Design and build custom software for startups and founders end-to-end.
Build CMS-powered sites with Sanity and modern frontend tooling.
Ship React Native & Flutter apps for e-commerce and customer-facing products.
Integrate auth, payments, analytics and third-party services.
